pairs.question: Quid ergo, si defecerit condicio?
pairs.answer: Verum est eum contra tabulas accipere bonorum possessionem.
pairs.derivation: Ulpian poses and answers his own question. Kept just the interrogative 'quid ergo, si defecerit condicio?'; the preceding sentence ('Sed si sub condicione scriptus sit... et ita iulianus quoque libro vicesimo tertio digestorum scripsit') is narrative setup with a citation interrupting it, so omitted. Answer is the full reply sentence; nothing follows it in the fragment. Capitalized 'Quid'.

pairs.question: Si ab ipso patre herede instituto filio eius fideicommissum fuerit relictum, cum morietur, an id conferendum est, quoniam utile est hoc fideicommissum?
pairs.answer: Et eveniet, ut pro eo habeatur, atque si post mortem patris relictum fuisset, nec cogetur hic conferre, quia moriente eo non fuisset.
pairs.derivation: Self-contained authorial question (the conditional setup plus the 'an...?' clause) answered by Ulpian himself. The question span is the whole interrogative sentence verbatim; the answer is the whole following sentence verbatim. No cuts needed.

pairs.question: Filium quis impuberem heredem scripsit eique substituit, emancipatum autem filium praeteriit: deinde uterque filius acceperunt bonorum possessionem: legata sunt etiam a substituto impuberis relicta non tantum liberis et parentibus, verum etiam extraneis: an mortuo impubere cogatur substitutus ea praestare?
pairs.answer: Et si quidem ab impubere relicta sunt, solis liberis parentibusque praestanda sunt: sin vero a substituto impuberis, omnibus eum praestare oportet habita ratione legis falcidiae, scilicet ut partis dimidiae, quae ad eum ex bonis patris pervenit, quartam, id est totius assis sescunciam retineat.
pairs.derivation: Verbatim case-setup retained so 'ea' (the legata) and 'substitutus'/'impubere' have referents; the framing word 'quaeritur,' before 'an' is dropped as meta-narration of the asking. Answer is the full two-branch reply sentence (the genuine answer); nothing is ellipted.

pairs.question: An libertus prohiberi potest a patrono in eadem colonia, in qua ipse negotiatur, idem genus negotii exercere?
pairs.derivation: Consultation: 'Quaero, an...' Dropped the framing verb 'Quaero,' and the speech tag 'scaevola respondit'. Question is the verbatim 'an...exercere'; answer is Scaevola's verbatim 'non posse prohiberi', capitalized.

pairs.question: Gaius seius decedens testamento ordinato inter filios suos iulium libertum suum, quasi et ipsum filium, ex parte heredem nominavit: an huiusmodi scriptura possit liberto statum condicionis mutare?
pairs.derivation: Verbatim setup kept so 'huiusmodi scriptura' has a referent. Dropped the framing verb 'quaero,' (it sits immediately before 'an') and the speech tag 'modestinus respondit'. Answer is Modestinus's verbatim reply, capitalized.

pairs.question: Titius puerum emit, quem post multos annos venire iussit: postea exoratus accepto ab eo pretio eum manumisit: an eum filius et heres manumissoris ut ingratum accusare possit?
pairs.answer: Posse, si nihil aliud esset impedimento.
pairs.derivation: Verbatim setup kept so 'eum' (the manumitted slave) has a referent. Dropped framing 'quaero,' and speech tag 'respondit'. Answer cut at its first full stop, before the elaborating 'nam plurimum interesse...' which distinguishes the cases rather than answering. Capitalized 'Posse'.

pairs.question: Titia post mortem mariti sui postumam enixa est: eidem titiae crimen adulterii sempronius apud praesidem provinciae obiecit: an in tempus pubertatis quaestio adulterii differri debeat, ne praeiudicium postumae fiat?
pairs.answer: Si ei pupillae, de qua quaeritur, bonorum paternorum quaestio non moveatur, sine causa tutores desiderare adulterii quoque quaestionem in tempus pubertatis pupillae differri.
pairs.derivation: Verbatim factual setup kept so the persons (Titia, the postuma) are intelligible. Dropped framing 'quaero,' and speech tag 'paulus respondit,'. Answer is Paulus's verbatim reply in full (one sentence); 'Si' capitalized.

pairs.question: An impubes, qui bonorum possessionem ex carboniano accepit, si, antequam possessio ad eum translata fuerit, pubes factus sit, petitoris partibus fungi debeat?
pairs.answer: In eo, quod a possessore petet, probationem ei incumbere.
pairs.derivation: Dropped the framing verb 'Quaeritur,' and the speech tag 'respondit'. Question and answer are each verbatim; 'In' capitalized.

pairs.question: An simul et pupillus ex carboniano et scripti heredes secundum tabulas bonorum possessionem haberent?
pairs.answer: Si filius non esset aut non accepisset contra tabulas vel ab intestato bonorum possessionem, simul et ipsum ex carboniano et scriptos heredes secundum tabulas habituros bonorum possessionem.
pairs.derivation: Dropped the framing 'Quaesitum est,' and the speech tag 'respondi,'. The question is the verbatim 'an...haberent'; the answer is the full verbatim reply sentence. 'Si' capitalized.

pairs.question: Si impubes non defendatur idcircoque missus sit in possessionem etiam adversarius eius, actiones hereditarias quis exercebit?
pairs.answer: Curatorem constitui debere, qui omnia curet actiones exerceat.
pairs.derivation: The conditional setup is kept so 'quis exercebit' is intelligible; the answer's attribution framing 'et ait iulianus libro vicensimo quarto digestorum' is dropped. Answer cut at its first full stop, before the digressing 'denique scribit etiam eum...'. Capitalized 'Curatorem'.
